name: Setup Complete Development Environment
description: Setup a full-stack development environment with multiple tools

task.instructions:
Setup a complete development environment including:
1. Python 3.11 with pip and virtualenv
2. Node.js 20.x with npm
3. Git with global config (user.name='Test User', user.email='test@example.com')
4. PostgreSQL 15 installed and running
5. Redis installed and running
6. Create a test project directory at /workspace/testproject
7. Initialize a git repository in that directory
8. Create a Python virtual environment in testproject/.venv
9. Create a package.json with name='test-project'
10. Verify all services are running and accessible
constraints: All services must be running simultaneously

commands: systemctl is-active postgresql || service postgresql status
systemctl is-active redis || service redis status

metadata.author: DesktopAgent Team
metadata.difficulty_justification: Complex multi-service setup requiring coordination and verification of multiple components
